text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: One more lap...!! Toryaaaaaahhh—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, she trained relentlessly 
to make the Japan Cup a truly special 
day... and her condition approached its 
absolute peak!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-Wah!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! When I posted on social 
media saying I'd do my best in tomorrow's 
Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There are tons and tons of comments saying 
"Good luck!"

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'm always inspired by your positive 
attitude, Machikane Tannhauser! Do your 
best!’"

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
""I'll be at the racetrack tomorrow to 
cheer you on! Run with everything you've 
got!""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Numerous comments poured into the chat, 
expressing their passionate support and 
high hopes for her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, everyone's really looking forward to 
it, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Uwoooooh~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run just one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And finally, the day of the Japan Cup 
arrived. For some reason, Matikane 
Tannhauser was nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Did I get the wrong racetrack again? Just 
as I was thinking that—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Tannhauser's Trainer? ...I need 
you to stay calm and listen."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Tannhauser... had a nosebleed and 
collapsed—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm told she's currently undergoing tests 
at the hospital. It's nothing serious, but 
upon hearing she won't be able to run 
today's race—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"The power of a 'protagonist' that moves 
people's hearts! I want to spark that in 
someone else once again!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "I want to become the 'protagonist'...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her entry in the Japan Cup was abruptly 
canceled. We rushed straight to the 
hospital.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Aah, did it again! Seriously, I always 
blow it right when it matters most!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I guess I got way too fired up today 
too... I felt dizzy, crashed down, and 
ugh, jeez...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Big tears began to spill and drip from 
Matikanetannhauser's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Urrgh...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on, seriously, why... What am I 
doing...?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I just... I can't even trust myself 
anym...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aw, look, they're crying.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, Nature...!? Didn't you go to 
your part-time job today!?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to focus on my part-time 
job when you're moping around like that?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I knew you were working hard for today 
and all, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
She was in prime condition, the absolute 
best, and yet, and yet, at the most 
crucial moment...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'm just no good. Maybe I can't 
be... the "protagonist" after all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikane Tannhauser hung her head. Looking 
at her with a resolute expression, Nice 
Nature――

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta face forward and hold my 
ground. Whining about it won't do any 
good.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser is the one who taught me this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's true that you might have betrayed the 
high expectations of the public today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I might've moved even further away from 
ever becoming the 'protagonist.'"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still, I have to look forward.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...That's how I feel right now. What 
about you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on top of that—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Machitan is crying! Don't cry, Turbo 
is here!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You can't shout in the hospital, Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next to arrive were Twin Turbo and Ikuno 
Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: E-E-E-Everyone!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There's something I'd like to show you, 
Tannhauser-san. Here it is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On Ikuno Dictus's smartphone, the Umatter 
timeline was displayed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Don't worry, next time for sure your 
long-awaited victory awaits!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘You're definitely getting 1st place in 
the next race! I'll be there to watch 
again, so do your best!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A massive flood of encouraging comments 
had arrived for Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
These are the comments that came in after 
hearing about the race withdrawal.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Tannhauser-san was an Umamusume 
who drew quite a lot of attention this 
time.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It would not be an exaggeration to say 
that this was the most anticipated race of 
your entire career."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Still... there's always the next time. If 
we couldn't take it today, all we have to 
do is win the next one. That's all."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All I have to do... is win next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those were words that sounded all too 
familiar.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yup! It's what you've been telling me all 
this time, right?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Right, Machitan! Let's definitely win the 
next race!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win next time and show 'em all! Just 
how amazing Machitan really is!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Turbo... ...Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser looked up at her 
friends who had rushed over to her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She roughly wiped away her tears.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it! I won't give up, I'll give it 
a shot...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a few days of rest and recovery, 
Matikane Tannhauser safely returned to the 
academy. And then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Everything is ready!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Let's make our next race the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I know that! The upcoming Arima Kinen is a 
high-profile race packed with fierce 
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Hayahide-san, an Umamusume currently at 
the absolute peak of her game, is running, 
and it's also Teio-san's comeback race—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-san, Ticket-san, Nature, 
Rice-san... A truly illustrious lineup is 
running!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Plus, since I only just recovered from 
collapsing, I've fallen completely behind! 
But still!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you want to win, you just have to win. 
That is what she taught me over these past 
three years.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the Arima Kinen. Next time, 
without fail, absolutely—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I want to win, and become a "protagonist" 
in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is next. All that is left 
is to sprint forth and dedicate this 
long-awaited victory.
